• The square d2 is covered by my bishop on g5 (since the bishop on g5 controls the diagonal d2–c1).  
• The squares e2 and f2 lie on rank 2, and they are controlled by my queen on h2 (which rules the entire 2nd rank).  

Thus, after 1...Rg1+ the White king has no legal move, no piece can capture the checking rook, and no block is available. This is checkmate.

So I now complete my move.

make_move g8g1
